worldcombat.skill.thrash.summary: When surrounded, sweep left then right to shove the enemies on top of you outward, ending on a heavy stomp: each sweep only covers the side it sweeps past; afterwards the user reels in confusion and its actions may fumble.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.use.0: Sweep one side clear of enemies pressing in on you
worldcombat.skill.thrash.use.1: Shove the enemies on top of you apart and break out of the press
worldcombat.skill.thrash.use.2: Clear what is underfoot with the closing stomp
worldcombat.skill.thrash.description.0: Left and right close sweeps end on a closing stomp, %2$s beats in all; the earlier beats deal about %1$s contact damage to every enemy on the side swept past, and the closing stomp's damage is multiplied by %3$s (no damage while airborne).
worldcombat.skill.thrash.description.1: The sweep radius is %1$s blocks and beats are %2$s apart; enemies hit are shoved up to %3$s blocks outward, and the user staggers up to %4$s blocks after each beat toward its movement intent (alternating sides with no input); whatever side was not swept stays safe for now.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.description.2: Afterwards the user reels in confusion for %1$s: each attempted action has a %2$s chance to be scattered, hurting the user for about 1.2%%-5%% of its max health (more with higher Attack); the backlash does not extend the daze.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.wild.on: Wild form: covers wider, shoves harder, dazes longer and has a longer wind-up and cooldown, but every swing hurts the user for %1$s of its max health (and each swing is slightly weaker).
worldcombat.skill.thrash.wild.off: Brawling form: never self-harms, recovers faster with a shorter cooldown and slightly stronger swings, but the radius and shove are narrower.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.growth.0: From level %1$s each swing rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.growth.1: From level %1$s each swing rises to %2$s and the stomp to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.preference.wild: On: covers wider, shoves harder, dazes longer and has a longer wind-up and cooldown, but every swing hurts the user for a share of its max health (and each swing is slightly weaker) - for being surrounded. Off (brawling): no self-harm and a narrower radius and shove, but a faster wind-up, a shorter cooldown and slightly stronger swings.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.preference.ai.m: The companion only considers thrashing when the threat is this close; smaller waits until contact, larger closes in first.
At least this many non-allies must stand inside the flail radius before thrashing; larger only uses it when surrounded, 1 uses it on sight.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.preference.ai.l: On: leaves a hold or stay post to push into a crowd. Off: only thrashes when it reaches someone from where it stands.
